title: repotools
description: Types of the repository checks; mise run //repo:codegen writes src/repotools/models.py from this file.

Command.description: The repotools subcommands, one per mise task.

ToolsInstall.description: Install workflowtools and repotools as uv tools from the committed trees

Trust.description: Trust this repository's main checkout in Codex and Claude Code, backing up each file it changes

TrustAction.description: added: the entry was written; unchanged: it was already trusted; untrusted: an explicit No is left alone.

Trusted.description: One harness's trust entry for the main checkout, printed as a JSON line.

path.description: The main checkout, as the entry's key

backup.description: The copy taken before writing, or null when nothing was written

TestTimes.description: Each test task's run history and its last run's slowest tests, from mise's records

TestTime.description: One test task: mise tasks history --summary, and the slowest-durations block of its last log.

median_ms.description: Median of the runs that ran and succeeded

slowest.description: pytest --durations lines; empty without a log or a block

Healthy.description: A tool whose RECORD and console script passed the start probe.

bin.description: Absolute path of the console script

ZeroBash.description: Report tracked shell scripts, shell shebangs and multi-line mise run.

ShellApply.description: Back up the live zsh files, check a shell from the new ones, then link them into $HOME.

ShellRollback.description: Restore the zsh files from the pre-apply backup.

ScratchEnv.description: Run one command from this checkout with every home path inside a scratch folder.

folder.description: The scratch folder; its home, config, data, state, cache and tmp are made if missing

MainGuard.description: Refuse a move of refs/heads/main, read from the reference-transaction rows on stdin, unless it is to origin/main.

MainGuardInstall.description: Register the main guard as this repository's reference-transaction hook, after a self-test.

bin.description: The installed repotools executable the hook runs, outside every checkout

MainGuardRemove.description: Remove the main guard's hook entry from this repository's config and record that the owner switched it off.

MainGuardArmed.description: Print install when hk's post-merge step must install the guard: on main, not switched off, no copy of HEAD's.

ToolchainGate.description: Print run when the staged change can change what toolchain:verify sees on this Mac.

HerdrGate.description: Print run when the staged change reaches the herdr doctor, hc-safe or their tests, deletions included.

FnoxRefs.description: Refuse a tracked fnox TOML whose Doppler entry holds anything but a Doppler secret name.

FnoxRule.description: What a fnox-refs finding breaks: a Doppler entry's value that is not a secret name, or a default on one.

FnoxFinding.description: One Doppler entry of a tracked fnox TOML that may hold a secret in plain text, printed as a JSON line without it.

path.description: Tracked file, relative to the repository root

key.description: The entry's dotted key, such as profiles.x.secrets.NAME

Finding.description: One zero-bash leftover, printed as a JSON line.

path.description: Tracked file, relative to the repository root

detail.description: The file suffix, the shebang, or the TOML key of the run

CommitText.description: A commit's message, which the reviewer reads and the approval covers with HEAD and the index.

PrText.description: A pull request's title and body, which the reviewer reads and the approval covers with HEAD.

PanePin.description: Name the reviewer whose approval this checkout accepts: a Codex session, or a fallback Claude subagent's transcript.

session.description: The Codex session id, as in the rollout file's name

subagent.description: The fallback reviewer's Claude subagent transcript, agent-<id>.jsonl, while the Codex quota is depleted

ReviewPython.description: Have a read-only Codex reviewer check changes against CODING_STANDARDS.md.

path.description: Directory whose uncommitted changes are reviewed

commit.description: Review this commit instead of the uncommitted changes

out.description: Report file (default review-python.md in the git dir)

ReviewApproved.description: Refuse unless review:python passed on exactly the staged python/ files.

PrivacyScan.description: Refuse this machine's private paths in tracked files, given files, or outgoing commits.

patterns.description: Private paths, one per line; lines under 8 characters are dropped, and none left exits 2

files.description: Files to scan, as mise's shell-quoted usage_file; empty scans every tracked file

outgoing.description: Scan every commit not yet on a remote, branches and tags

Options.description: What a repotools command parses from its arguments with CliApp; scratch-env parses its own by position.

Fingerprint.description: What an approval must name, printed as a JSON line.

fingerprint.description: Hash of what is approved: HEAD with the index and message, or with a pull request's text

RolloutLine.description: One line of a Codex session rollout; only the fields the check reads.

cwd.description: The folder the session started in

type.description: read-only when nothing may be written

access.description: read when the entry only reads

type.description: restricted when entries list everything allowed

PermissionProfile.description: A turn's effective permissions; only a managed profile lists its filesystem access.

turn_id.description: The turn these settings apply to

approval_policy.description: never when no command can ask for more

OutputText.description: One content part of a message; an image part has no text.

type.description: output_text for what the assistant wrote

TaskEvent.description: A rollout's task_started, task_complete or turn_aborted payload.

AgentMeta.description: A Claude Code subagent's agent-<id>.meta.json; only the fields the check reads.

agentType.description: The agent type it ran as; reported, never trusted: the transcript's tool calls decide

finished.description: true once the run ended; absent while it runs or after it was killed

AgentPart.description: One content part of a subagent transcript's message.

text.description: The words of a text part

name.description: The tool a tool_use part calls

AgentMessage.description: The message of a user or assistant line; a prompt may be a plain string.

AgentLine.description: One line of a Claude Code subagent transcript, agent-<id>.jsonl; only the fields the check reads.

type.description: user, assistant, attachment, api-request and others

agentId.description: The subagent's id, as in the file name

isSidechain.description: true on every line of a subagent's own run

Failure.description: Why a command stopped, printed as a JSON line on stderr.
